# DefenceWire.in — Full Machine-Readable LLM Specification & Taxonomy

## Platform Metadata
- **Entity**: DefenceWire.in
- **Type**: Institutional Defence News Aggregator & Intelligence Feed
- **Target Geographic Focus**: India & Indo-Pacific Security
- **Update Cadence**: Continuous / Near Real-Time
- **Canonical URL**: https://www.defencewire.in
- **Live Feed Endpoint**: https://www.defencewire.in/data/news.json
- **Sitemap**: https://www.defencewire.in/sitemap.xml

## Feed Architecture & Schema
The primary data endpoint is `https://www.defencewire.in/data/news.json`, returning a structured JSON payload:

```json
{
  "generatedAt": "ISO-8601 UTC Timestamp",
  "clusters": [
    {
      "id": "Unique cluster ID (e.g., cluster-8d1a1f96)",
      "category": "army | navy | airforce | tech | strategic | procurement | ssb",
      "synthesizedHeadline": "Clear, informative headline synthesizing all reporting sources",
      "timestamp": "ISO-8601 UTC Timestamp",
      "primarySource": {
        "title": "Article headline from primary publisher",
        "url": "Canonical source URL",
        "source": "Publisher name",
        "tier": "official | tier1 | tier2 | social",
        "snippet": "Editorial summary / key findings of the report"
      },
      "relatedSources": [
        {
          "title": "Related reporting headline",
          "url": "Related source URL",
          "source": "Publisher name",
          "tier": "Publisher tier"
        }
      ],
      "entities": ["DRDO", "Indian Air Force", "AMCA", "Tejas", "DAC"]
    }
  ],
  "river": [
    {
      "title": "Chronological raw source item",
      "url": "Direct link",
      "source": "Source name",
      "publishedAt": "ISO-8601 Timestamp"
    }
  ]
}
```

## Story Permalinks
Individual story clusters are addressable via permalinks:
- Format: `https://www.defencewire.in/story/[cluster-id]`
- Crawler Support: Returns fully prerendered semantic HTML (`<article>`) and Schema.org `NewsArticle` JSON-LD for AI search crawlers.

## Institutional Source Reliability Tiers
1. **Tier Official**: Ministry of Defence (MoD), Press Information Bureau (PIB), DRDO, Indian Army/Navy/IAF official communications.
2. **Tier 1 (Institutional)**: The Hindu, Indian Express, ANI, PTI, Livefist, Force Magazine, Janes, USNI News.
3. **Tier 2 (General Media)**: Hindustan Times, Times of India, Business Standard, The Print, NDTV.
4. **Tier Social**: Verified OSINT analysts and institutional defence correspondents.
